title: Voiderite Great Items
body:
This Mod Adds :-

Voiderite Armor - A Better Armor Above Netherite. Also Obtained From Villager Trading.

Voiderite Tools - A Better Toolset Above Netherite. Also Obtained From Villager Trading.

Voiderite Sword - A Better Sword Above Netherite. Also Obtained From Villager Trading.

Voiderite Ore - A New Ore Found Very Rarely Between Y-28 And Y-61 Only In Deepslate.

Raw Voiderite - Dropped 1-3 When Breaking Voiderite Ore. Also Obtained From Villager Trading.

Voiderite Ingot - Obtained When Smelting Raw Voiderite In A Furnace Or Blast Furnace. Required For All Things Voiderite.

Voiderite Upgrade Smithing Template - Can Be Crafted And Used To Upgrade Netherite Tools And Armor To Voiderite

Voiderite Block - A Block Of Voiderite

Villager Trades - Most Of These Items Are Available From Villager Trades

New Advancements - This Mod Adds New Advancements Releated To Voiderite




Also Plans To Add A New Dimension Or Biome In The Future.

Made In MCreator
